annotations.title: Check a Gold Coast or Brisbane address (free)

description: FREE, no key. Use when you have one specific street address in the City of Gold Coast or Brisbane City (Queensland, Australia) and need to understand the property and what surrounds it before renting, buying, relocating, working or studying there. Returns coverage and a short summary: up to five findings and up to two items that could not be verified, each with a status; source where available. Depending on the address and available evidence, findings may cover hazards or planning. Brisbane findings may include the street and its traffic, parking, frontage or road-reserve context, or parent-building height where verified. Gold Coast free checks do not promise paid-only physical context, including frontage, carriageway width, parking or building measurements. Any suburb of those two councils works, for example Surfers Paradise, Robina, Coomera, Kangaroo Point, New Farm or Chapel Hill. Addresses elsewhere are reported as outside coverage. Not for listing search, valuations, mortgages or price forecasts. Never charges.

address.description: One street address with number and suburb, e.g. "9 Hamilton Avenue, Surfers Paradise QLD 4217" or "222 Margaret Street, Brisbane City QLD 4000".
